revisedDescription: On the homescreen, where staff enter a vehicle's registration and VIN, also let them fill in the make and model right there — instead of having to save first and then open Edit just to add it. This just brings that field forward onto the intake screen; nothing about how make/model is stored or shown elsewhere changes.

questions.prompt: Is this the right idea: add a make & model field to the homescreen, next to registration and VIN, so you don't have to edit the vehicle afterward just to set it?
options: Close, but not quite -- see my comment
